sn35.20:1.7: If you take pleasure in Dhammas, you take pleasure in suffering.
sn35.20:1.8: If you take pleasure in suffering, you’re not free from suffering, I say.
sn35.20:2.1: “And, mendicants, if you don’t take pleasure in sights, you don’t take pleasure in suffering.
sn35.20:2.2: If you don’t take pleasure in suffering, you’re not free from suffering, I say.
sn35.20:2.7: If you don’t take pleasure in Dhammas, you don’t take pleasure in suffering.
sn35.20:2.8: If you don’t take pleasure in suffering, you’re not free from suffering, I say.”
